gpa_raw: The original spreadsheet legend codes this field 1=Yes and 0=No. Do not treat the field as a continuous GPA prognostic score.
time_origin: First BM imaging date is shifted to 1900-01-01; clinical event times are relative days, negative before first BM imaging.
rn_status: Only a numeric RN timing field is recorded_event_time; blanks remain unknown, not event-free.
sequence_hints: Name-based hints are candidate labels only; inspect DICOM acquisition metadata and images before feature extraction.
